gauge.name: Nippersink Creek near Spring Grove

impacts.statement: US-12 is threatened at Solon Mills.
North Solon Road threatened near US-12 at Solon Mills.
US-12 is threatened west of Fox Lake.
Wisconsin and Southern Railroad tracks threatened west and east of Spring Grove.
Wilmot Road is threatened east of Spring Grove.

Industrial structures threatened along Winn Road in Spring Grove. Solon Road/Main Street and Winn Road north of the creek are threatened in Spring Grove. South Solon Road threatened near US-12 at Solon Mills.
A few structures threatened along Blivin Street in Spring Grove. Blivin Street threatened in Spring Grove.
Numerous residences along creek near US-12 and State Park Road are threatened west of Fox Lake. Parking lots along Winn Road threatened south of the creek in Spring Grove.
Roadways at Nippersink Canoe Base are threatened east of Spring Grove.
A few residences are threatened along Linden Road east of Spring Grove. Spring Grove fish hatchery property is threatened.
Linden Road is threatened east of Spring Grove. Boathouses threatened along the creek near US-12 and State Park Road.
Prairie Club campground threatened west of Spring Grove.
Large sections of Nippersink Canoe Base Conservation Area are threatened east of Spring Grove.
McHenry County considers closure of Nippersink Creek.

value.label: North American Vertical Datum of 1988
value.description: A fixed reference for elevations determined by geodetic leveling. The datum was derived from a general adjustment of the first-order terrestrial leveling nets of the United States, Canada, and Mexico. In the adjustment, only the height of the primary tidal bench mark, referenced to the International Great Lakes Datum of 1985 (IGLD 85) local mean sea level height value, at Father Point, Rimouski, Quebec, Canada was held fixed, thus providing minimum constraint. NAVD 88 and IGLD 85 are identical. However, NAVD 88 bench mark values are given in Helmert orthometric height units while IGLD 85 values are in dynamic heights. See International Great Lakes Datum of 1985, National Geodetic Vertical Datum of 1929, and geopotential difference. NAVD 88 should not be used as Mean Sea Level.
